blurb: Guests rent canoes, kayaks, rafts, or tubes for river trips. An advance deposit is required for rentals. Cancellation must be made three days before the float to avoid full charges.
extraNote: Advance deposit of $15 required on canoes and kayaks · Advance deposit of $50 required on rafts · Cancellation deadline is three days before each float · Full payment charged if cancellation policy is neglected · Repair charges $25 to replacement cost for lost or damaged boats · Lost or damaged gear replacement costs $15 per paddle, life jacket, or seat cushion
